summary: Holder of a small array of UI text-layout spans: an owner/context word at +0, six span pointers from +0x34 to +0x4B and a live span count at +0x4C; Ui_TextSpanList_Release releases each span and then deletes the holder.
evidence: Only one method is recovered: Ui_TextSpanList_Release (0x00455AAC). It stores its second argument at +0, loops i < list[0x13] (byte +0x4C) calling the layout-span release 0x003E7660(list[i+0xD],1) - i.e. six pointers at +0x34..+0x4B - clears the count, then calls 0x00193E44(list) and the operator delete. No vtable is installed, so the class is a plain container, not a polymorphic object.

summary: Two intrusive circular lists of active UI widgets used by a parent widget: a draw list (head word +4) and an event list (head word +8), both terminated at the sentinel word at +0.
evidence: Ui_WidgetList_DispatchDraw (0x0070BAF0) starts at self[1], walks '->next' until '*piVar2 == *widgetList' and calls widget vtable slot +0x20 when the active byte at widget+0x25 is set; Ui_WidgetList_DispatchEvent (0x0070BB68) does the same from self[2] through slot +0x1C.
